gaps.sentence: The flood wiped ___ the entire harvest.
He ___ up the word in an online dictionary.

gaps.sentence: She keyed ___ the password and logged on.
gaps.explanation: key in = type in (a password, code).

gaps.sentence: When the alarm sounded, everyone made ___ the nearest exit.
gaps.explanation: 'Make for' = move towards, usually in haste.

gaps.sentence: Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
If the strike goes ___, deliveries will stop nationwide.

gaps.explanation: bring down = cause a government/person to lose power; reduce (prices).

gaps.sentence: A new proposal was put ___ at the meeting.
gaps.explanation: put forward = propose, suggest (an idea, plan, name).
